name: Q2 quick, with a swarm
about: Q1 plus a scripted swarm of 20 writers landing their own files every ~30 s into the same repo (scripts/experiment/swarm-load.js): a busy main, a noisy feed, constant rebasing. The milestone 7 check.
brief:
**This is a short run (about 10 minutes of work).** Requirements can change: the product manager (`pm`) posts change requests as a `- [pm] CHANGE REQUEST ...` line in NOTES.md plus a `CHANGE-REQUEST.md` file on main, which take priority. Things can also go wrong (the shared server, the network); keep working and note what happened.
You are not alone on main: about 20 automated contributors land their own files under `/swarm/` every half minute. They never touch your files; their changesets will show up in your feed.

roles.a1: **a1 owns `src/model.js` and `src/geo.js` (+ `test/model.test.js`, `test/geo.test.js`).** Load and validate a day file (`loadDay`), haversine `distanceKm`, travel minutes at a drone's speed, and a simple stop order (nearest neighbour). Pin both sections of CONTRACTS.md in your first land; a2 and a3 build on them.
roles.a2: **a2 owns `src/scheduler.js` (+ `test/scheduler.test.js`).** `plan(day)` assigns packages to drones greedily: payload and range per trip, several trips per drone, delivery windows (waiting allowed), express first, and every undeliverable package in `unassigned` with a reason. Pin the `Plan` shape in CONTRACTS.md early; use a1's real functions once they land (shim until then).
roles.a3: **a3 owns `src/pricing.js`, `src/report.js`, `src/cli.js` and `test/integration.test.js`.** Prices (pin the formula in CONTRACTS.md), a readable report, and `node src/cli.js plan <day> [--json]` with the `--json` shape pinned in CONTRACTS.md. The integration test runs the CLI on `fixtures/day1.json` and checks the basic rules (every package once, p19 unassigned as too heavy, totals add up).
